You know when adjustments are needed and take action when something is not running as it should. Changing over machines and production lines when required Monitoring the production process and making adjustments when necessary Identifying and solving minor production disruptions Performing visual inspections and quality checks Making sure products meet the required quality standards Following hygiene, food safety, health and safety procedures Keeping your work area clean, safe and organized You’ll work in a cooled and highly hygienic production environment. The production site in Wijchen is equipped with advanced slicing and packaging technology and modern machinery. These technologies allow DeliBarn to process products efficiently while meeting strict food safety and quality standards. Within DeliBarn, innovation, quality, teamwork, and personal development are highly valued. The company continues to invest in modern technology and efficient production processes, giving employees the opportunity to learn, develop their skills, and grow within the organization. Apply today and become part of the DeliBarn team in Wijchen. Your next career step could start here!

To create demand in the market, contact and engage with end customers which involves cold calls as well, follows opportunities, quotes. .Develop and maintain strong relationships with key distributors, customers, and strategic accounts to drive business growth.
.Identify new business opportunities through customer engagement, market analysis, and lead development

.Support customer projects, sample coordination, and awarded business follow-up.
.Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to efficient sales processes.
.Keep the funnel up to date and clean.
.Manage customer inquiries and escalations by coordinating solutions with internal teams.
.Provide market insights and strategic feedback to support future business development.
 
Requirements
.Preferably bachelor's degree (engineering, business administration, economics)
.3 - 5 years of experience in a commercial environment
.Driver Licence B

What's in it for you

.A varied role that combines inside sales with hands-on account management.
.The freedom to develop new business and grow your own territory across the UK & Scandinavia.
.An international working environment with short lines of communication.
.A competitive salary in line with your experience, plus room to grow as well as travel opportunities.

As a Line Leader, you are responsible for the daily operation of a production line. You make sure production runs safely, on time, and according to quality standards. You lead a team of operators, support them during the shift, and help solve any issues on the line.

- Lead and support a team of production employees and operators
- Make sure production targets are met
- Check product quality, food safety, hygiene, and safety standards

- Experience as a team leader or supervisor is an advantage
- Knowledge of HACCP is a plus
- Good communication skills
- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift system (5:30-15:00 and 15:00-23:30)

- A fixed-term contract with the opportunity for a permanent contract

- An 8% holiday allowance

- A comprehensive pension plan through VLEP
- A future-focused working environment
- Opportunities for training, personal development, and career growth
